_note: JSE conformance corpus - BLOCK-SCOPE MUTATION (2026-08-22). The last R11 semantic: a block body (a block-bodied lambda, an IIFE, a <variable>/function body) can BUILD a value imperatively - dotted, computed-key and indexed assignment into a scope name, compound assignment (+= -= *= /= %=), and statement-position .push(...) all write the LOCAL by REBUILDING it (value semantics: an assignment through a second name never aliases the first - the Swift dictionary law, pinned by value-semantics-boundary). Writes stay in the block scope, never the store (the evalBlock purity contract, unchanged). A write into a missing nest creates it (bounded-total: never a throw). pop()/shift() remain PURE reads (stdlib-002); push has no pure reading, so in statement position it grows the local. Before this file every one of these was silently dropped - the reduce-accumulator idiom returned {} on all three runtimes (runtime-pressure R11). Swift = reference (record lane authoritates expected).
